answer: Each agent carries an ivory lantern, a token re-lit each epoch by a random beacon challenge. The beacon picks a random subset and demands a compute heartbeat, proof of live work within 60 seconds, pinned to a public trellis. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must answer 1,000 simultaneous heartbeats: at $0.02 each that is $20 per epoch, while one honest agent pays $0.02 and keeps its reward. A missed heartbeat dims the lantern and freezes rewards.
